title: Execution from a safe block
statement: Let $s$ be a statement and $\sigma$ a state. Suppose every operation in the block is safe in sequence from $\sigma$, and the state obtained by applying the block's assignments and stores satisfies $Q$. If the block cost is at most $T$, then $s$ has an execution from $\sigma$ of cost at most $T$ ending in a state satisfying $Q$.
